_comment: commit-gate-refusals.json — each pre-commit gate's own refusal lines, any one of
which names it, read by scripts/lib/arm-secondary.js to say which gate refused a commit
(#2175). scripts/lib/arm-secondary.test.ts counts each line in the gate's source, so
rewording a refusal at any of its sites fails it until this file follows (#2298).
A line is a literal string printed at one site, or an object: `sites` where it prints
at more than one; `from` and `via` where the source builds it, `from` being the
source's own spelling with its one `$name` hole filled by the gate's id, which
.husky/pre-commit passes to the shell function `via`. A gate with `tool` prints
through a third-party binary, so its lines are checked against no source.
